titles.romaji: Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Yume no Naka no Rondo
titles.english: Magical Princess Minky Momo: La Ronde in my Dream
titles.native: 魔法のプリンセス ミンキーモモ夢の中の輪舞

description:
Minky Momo travels to an island where she finds a land of children and gets tangled up in an absurd, no-holds-barred standoff against the world's nations. Has "Dr. Strangelove" references.

(Source: AniDB)
